edges.sentence: On 2026-08-29, Associated Press reported “Según la Fiscalía entre 2010 y 2018 funcionó una red de corrupción que recibió sobornos equivalentes al 4% del valor de la construcción de una central hidroeléctrica por parte de Sinohydro.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Prosecutors said a corruption network operated from 2008 to 2018, collecting bribes equal to 4% of the value of the project carried out by Sinohydro.”.

On 2026-08-29, Associated Press reported “They said the money was distributed through domestic and international transactions to public officials and other beneficiaries, including Moreno.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Prosecutors said a corruption network operated from 2008 to 2018, collecting bribes equal to 4% of the value of the project carried out by Sinohydro.”.

On 2026-08-29, Associated Press reported “All were ordered to repay triple what they received illicitly within a period of 90 days.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Tanto Moreno como los otros 19 implicados, uno de los cuales fue declarado inocente, deberán restituir el triple del dinero ilícito recibido en un plazo de 90 días y presentar disculpas públicas en un mes.”.

On 2026-08-29, Associated Press reported “Moreno, who was present for the reading of the verdict, is 73 years old and has a physical disability that prevents him from walking.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “de 73 años y con una discapacidad física que le impide caminar”.

On 2026-08-29, Associated Press reported “The wife and daughter each received 30-month sentences.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Junto a Moreno —acusado de autor directo de cohecho por influir en la entrega del contrato-- fueron condenados a 30 meses de cárcel su esposa Rocío González, su hija Irina Moreno, y sancionó con distintas penas a dos hermanos y una cuñada, de quienes —dijo— recibieron beneficios y ayudaron a encubrir los pagos, según la sentencia.”.

On 2026-08-29, Associated Press reported “Former Ecuadorian President Lenín Moreno was sentenced Friday to 5 years in prison after a court found him guilty of accepting bribes from a Chinese company in exchange for helping it secure a contract to build a hydroelectric plant.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Un tribunal de justicia de Ecuador sentenció el viernes a cinco años de prisión al expresidente Lenín Moreno tras encontrarlo culpable de recibir sobornos de la empresa china Sinohydro para la construcción de una de las más importantes centrales hidroeléctricas del país andino.”.
